lines.text: 61. The correct statements about metal carbonyls are
A. The metal-carbon bonds in metals carbonyls
possess both o and z-character.
B. Due to synergic bonding interactions between
metals and CO ligand the metal-carbon bond
becomes weak.
C. The metal-carbon o bond is formed by the
donation of lone pair of electrons on the carbonyl
carbon into a vacant orbital of metal.
D. The metal-carbon a bond is formed by the
donation of electrons from filled d-orbital of metal
into vacant 2* orbital of CO.
Choose the correct answer from the options given
below :
(1) A and B only (2) A, C and D only
(3) Band C only (4) A and D only
Ans. (2)
Sol. (A) The metal-carbon bonds in metal carbonyls
possess both o and z-character.
(B) The metal to ligand bonding creates a synergic
effect which strengthens the bond between CO and
the metal i.e. metal carbon bond becomes strong.
(C) The metal-carbon o is formed by the donation
of lone pair of electrons on the carbonyl carbon
into a vacant orbital of metal.
(D) The metal-carbon 2 bond is formed by the
donation of electrons from filled d-orbial of metal
into vacant 2* orbital of CO.
Correct answer are A, C, D
